prompt:
Repair the revisioned availability calendar. render(records, lo, hi, asof) returns
[start,end,value] segments for the half-open window [lo,hi). Each record is
[key,revision,start,end,value]. For each key use its highest revision <= asof;
last input record wins ties for that key. A null value retracts that key entirely.
Select revisions before clipping to the window, even if an update moves away or
has empty bounds. At overlapping points choose the active key with highest
revision, breaking ties by lexicographically smallest key. Omit gaps. Merge
adjacent equal values even across different winners, never across gaps. Return
[] for an empty window. evaluate(records, windows) returns render results in
input order for [lo,hi,asof] queries. No call may mutate inputs. Timestamps are
signed integers, potentially trillions apart; operate on boundaries, not ticks.

Files: calendar_store.py, timeline.py. Run the visible tests before finishing.
